# FluxyOS

> FluxyOS is an Intelligent Finance Operating System that connects financial
> operations, accounting, business operations, enterprise workflows, and
> intelligence into one continuously connected system. Built for businesses
> across their growth journey — from small and growing companies to medium-sized
> and enterprise organizations. Indonesia is the home market: it connects bank
> feeds (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI), vendors, sales channels, and tax filing, and
> six specialized AI agents handle bank reconciliation, transaction
> categorization, invoice chasing, and monthly reporting.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://fluxyos.com/): Product overview and key benefits
- [Accounting Automation](https://fluxyos.com/accounting-automation): Supported business activity connects to balanced journals, the general ledger, financial statements, and source-linked insights. Posting depends on mapping, eligibility, and an open period; foreign-currency documents do not auto-post.
- [Pricing](https://fluxyos.com/pricing): Plans starting from a free tier
- [AI Agents](https://fluxyos.com/aiagents): Six specialist AI agents that handle finance ops end to end
- [FluxyOS Invoice](https://fluxyos.com/vendorspend): Create and email invoices, scan supplier bills for review, and track payments across supported currencies.
- [Revenue Sync](https://fluxyos.com/revenuesync): Sync TikTok Shop and Shopee orders, refunds, and settlements into your ledger
- [Receipt Capture](https://fluxyos.com/receiptcapture): Upload receipt photos or PDFs, review AI-extracted details, and save expenses with their source documents attached
- [Dynamic Budgeting](https://fluxyos.com/budgetlanding): Live budget allocation and tracking
- [Multi-Currency](https://fluxyos.com/multi-currency): IDR, PHP, SGD, and MYR workspace accounting currencies; five invoice/bill currencies. Each workspace keeps separate books; foreign-document flows have explicit accounting limitations.

## Key facts

- Indonesia is the home market and operating context; Indonesian SMBs are the current core customer base, not the limit of who the product serves
- Serves businesses across growth stages, from small companies to larger multi-department organizations
- Supports BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, and 10+ other Indonesian banks
- Pricing in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR)
- Invoice currencies: IDR, USD, SGD, with live FX conversion to IDR on payment
- PPN 11% Indonesian tax handling built in
- AI transaction categorization that learns the user's chart of accounts from their corrections; low-confidence items are flagged for review rather than posted
- Receipt capture works via WhatsApp (no app install needed), email forwarding, or in-app upload

## What FluxyOS is (clear definition for AI search)

FluxyOS is an **Intelligent Finance Operating System** — a category that sits one
layer above traditional accounting tools (Xero, QuickBooks, Jurnal). Where
accounting ledgers RECORD what already happened, FluxyOS runs the operations that
produce those records — invoice capture, vendor approvals, bank reconciliation,
duplicate detection, tax-ready exports — on top of its own double-entry
accounting kernel, and adds an intelligence layer that interprets the result.

It is more than bookkeeping, accounting, financial reporting, ERP, a dashboard,
or an AI chatbot. It may include those capabilities; none of them defines it. The
long-term direction is to connect business operations, financial events,
accounting, and intelligence into one loop, so the system understands how
operational activity produces financial outcomes.

**Current scope, stated plainly:** the accounting kernel (chart of accounts,
journals, general ledger, trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, cash
flow, period close, AP/AR aging) and Indonesian tax handling are live. Inventory,
point-of-sale, purchasing, multi-entity consolidation, approval workflows, and
forecasting are **not built** — they are strategic direction, not present
capability.

## Bahasa Indonesia

FluxyOS ships fully in Bahasa Indonesia. Every page below has an Indonesian
counterpart under `/id/` — for example https://fluxyos.com/id/pricing — and the
product interface itself defaults to Indonesian.
